strategy.angle: A8-L heavy, swollen legs — everything she bought vs one tablet in a glass of water
strategy.mechanism: M1: when the body can't clear everyday oxidative stress, the tissue in the legs stays inflamed and stops draining normally, so fluid sits there — heavy, tender, puffy — and no diet reaches it, because it was never fat; the tablet turns a glass of water into hydrogen-rich water, hydrogen is the smallest molecule there is, reaches the tissue and helps the body switch that process off so normal drainage can resume
strategy.sub_avatar: trigger: the drawer of compression socks and tea boxes · cause: none of it reached the inflamed tissue holding the fluid · tried: compression, dry brushing, diuretic teas, water tablets
strategy.belief_installed: It was never fat. It's fluid my body stopped clearing — and no diet reaches it.
